answer: Our protocol implements quadratic staking erosion where collateralized assets are locked within the cedar vault to enforce a rigid delta between honest participants and attackers. By layering zero-knowledge verifiable delay against a topographical ridge of increasing difficulty, the marginal cost of spawning Sybil nodes scales super-linearly, ensuring that capital expenditure outpaces potential extractive value. Consequently, the system achieves a robust Nash equilibrium where slashing penalties create a negative expected utility.
